⚙️ یک خط قابل‌ممیزی

System map →

From tick to ledger, every stage is isolated behind hexagonal ports. Promotion between stages requires an operator decision on reproducible evidence.

01📡MARKET DATAMT5 ticks and bars via ports — the domain never touches the broker.↓02🧬CAUSAL FEATURESStrictly causal 50D features (INV-008), NaN/Inf deterministic fallbacks.↓03🧠INFERENCE · SCALPNETScalpNet — dual-path TCN + self-attention on artifact manifests.↓04♟️SMC POLICY~30 SMC/ICT rules gate every signal into a proposal.↓05🛡️RISK ENGINEKelly sizing, margin ≤20%, HARD_MAX_LOTS, circuit breaker — enforced in the execution path.↓06⚡EXECUTIONOrder state machine, protection ledger, recovery budget, account-identity fail-safe.↓07🧾ACCOUNTINGImmutable audit ledger (SQLite WAL) off the tick hot path (INV-001).↓08👁️OBSERVABILITYSeverity-split logs, incidents, forensic snapshot, read-only notifier (INV-010).↓09🔁RESEARCH LOOPResearch consumes the same contracts: dataset → walk-forward → OOS → replay.

✦ چرا نکسوس

Not a claim of alpha — a way of treating claims. Evidence grades every capability; candidates never promote themselves.

⚖️

Evidence before claims

Metrics without evidence render n/a. Negative results are published — the 70D candidate was rejected by our own OOS gate.

کاوش →🧬

Causal feature engineering

Strictly causal 50D contract (INV-008) with deterministic fallbacks — identical for live, replay and training, pinned by schema hash.

کاوش →🔬

Deterministic research

Purged + embargoed walk-forward, bit-exact replay, fingerprinted datasets, models and runs with full provenance.

کاوش →🛡️

Invariant risk engine

Hard clamps live in the execution path: Kelly sizing, margin ≤20%, HARD_MAX_LOTS, kill switch — not in a comment.

کاوش →👁️

Runtime truth

Broker facts and runtime gates outrank intent and stale caches. Gates are authorities; settings are intent.

کاوش →🕵️

Forensic observability

Severity-split logs, incident correlation, deploy gate and the published bug ledger — every failure leaves evidence.

کاوش →

▦ سه حالت — ریسک با ساختار

The safety model is architectural: PAPER is the default, SHADOW can never place orders, LIVE needs explicit operator confirmation.

DEFAULT

🟢 PAPER — محیط امن

Fully simulated market and orders. For first run, development and UI work — no broker connection at all.

مستندات →
ZERO AUTHORITY

👁 SHADOW — فید زنده · صفر اختیار سفارش

Evaluate signals, gates and the full pipeline on real market data — while research, shadow and learning components physically cannot place orders.

مستندات →
EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION

🔴 LIVE — اختیار سفارش واقعی

Broker IPC / ZMQ with an account-identity fail-safe. LIVE requires explicit operator confirmation and inherits every risk clamp.

مستندات →

🔬 یک آزمایشگاه پژوهش، نه جعبهٔ سیاه

ماتریس کامل →

Historical data becomes falsifiable evidence through a fixed chain. Each capability carries an evidence grade — and rejections stay published.

  1. DATASET
  2. FEATURE CONTRACT
  3. MODEL
  4. EXPERIMENT
  5. WALK-FORWARD
  6. OOS GATE
  7. REPLAY
  8. VALIDATION
  9. PROMOTION
قابلیتوضعیت
50D live contract (scalp_v1)CERTIFIED
Walk-forward + hard OOS gateCERTIFIED
Artifact-first Model FactoryIMPLEMENTED
70D contract (Base+News+Liquidity)EXPERIMENTAL
70D OOS evidence (real data)NOT_ELIGIBLE
Counterfactual engine (NO_TRADE walk)RESEARCH

The 70D candidate (Base+News+Liquidity) is research, not production: the hard OOS gate returned NOT_ELIGIBLE on real-data walk-forward. The live contract stays 50D until a candidate clears every gate and an operator promotes it.

📚 کاوش در مستندات

🚀

شروع

نصب، اجرا و پیکربندی موتور. حالت PAPER پیش‌فرض است؛ SHADOW داده زنده با صفر اختیار سفارش می‌دهد.

📌

پروژه

نکسوس چیست، چه چیزی گواهی‌شده و چه چیزی آزمایشی است، و به کجا می‌رود — همه با درجه‌بندی شواهد.

🗺️

معماری

موتور چگونه ساخته شده: لایه‌های شش‌ضلعی، مسیر تیک تا تصمیم، حکمرانی مدل و حلقه هوش.

🔬

پژوهش

داده تاریخی چگونه به شواهد ابطال‌پذیر تبدیل می‌شود — دیتاست، بک‌تست، walk-forward، OOS، بازپخش، خلاف‌واقع.

🧪

مهندسی

گیت‌های کیفیت، معماری CI، فرایند انتشار و وضعیت امنیتی.

🧭

راهنما

کار روزانه با موتور: CLI، REST API، عیب‌یابی، گردش‌کارهای رایج.

🤝

مشارکت

قرارداد مهندسی، مالکیت مستندات و نحوه افزودن زبان جدید.

📚

مرجع

مرجع CLI، واژه‌نامه، اصطلاحات و پاسخ‌های صادقانه در پرسش‌های متداول.
